subtitle: Lesson 3 · The math behind every IP address

code:
/24  = 255.255.255.0      = 256 addresses, 254 usable hosts
/25  = 255.255.255.128    = 128 addresses, 126 usable hosts
/26  = 255.255.255.192    = 64 addresses,  62 usable hosts
/27  = 255.255.255.224    = 32 addresses,  30 usable hosts
/30  = 255.255.255.252    = 4 addresses,   2 usable hosts
caption: Usable hosts = 2^(host bits) - 2 — minus the network and broadcast address.

code:
Network address:   192.168.1.0    (reserved)
First usable host: 192.168.1.1
Last usable host:  192.168.1.30
Broadcast address: 192.168.1.31   (reserved)
caption: 5 host bits -> 2^5 = 32 total, minus 2 reserved = 30 usable.
